external_bridge.question: For a declared aza3 taxon x range-sector slot, which bounded candidate patches are scientifically justified for current-occurrence verification before exact-site freezing?

occurrence_input_freeze.taxon_matching: exact operational concept or explicitly reviewed synonym/concept crosswalk; no fuzzy substitution

primary_local_anchor_gate.precision_override: source-backed manual precision review frozen before field outcomes only

occurrence_evidence_typing.historical_or_region_only_rule: May constrain taxon/range context or sentinel construction but cannot be converted into a pseudo-exact current-population anchor.

discovery_regimes.LOCAL_CONTINUATION: Eligible recent anchor exists in the declared ecological component; known-point exclusion remains mandatory.
discovery_regimes.DETACHED_COMPONENT: Eligible anchor exists but a structurally similar ecological component is disconnected by an ecological gap/barrier; reported separately from local continuation.
discovery_regimes.SENTINEL: No eligible local anchor exists; use broad robust support plus spatially balanced exploration and report separately.
discovery_regimes.ABSTAIN_LOCAL_PATCH: Available occurrence/structure evidence cannot justify a bounded local patch without false precision.

effort_layer_rule: Develop budget/day/stopping only in a separately frozen successor after standardized prospective detection and non-detection data with effort exist.
